\section{Introduction}
Deep learning has revolutionized artificial intelligence in recent decades.
We extend our evaluation to large-scale benchmark datasets in this revised version.
Entity resolution is a fundamental problem in data science \cite{vaswani2017attention}.
Prior studies have explored citation parsing with heuristics \cite{devlin2018bert}.

\begin{itemize}
\item First contribution is multi-file hierarchical parsing.
\item Second contribution is machine learning reference matching.
\item Third contribution is extensive error analysis.
\end{itemize}
